# HST Architects

> HST Architects is a Dubai interior design, renovation and landscaping studio delivering villas, offices, showrooms and outdoor spaces across the UAE.

HST Architects is the design practice of HST Group, a licensed UAE building maintenance and technical
services company operating from Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Office 1603, Downtown Dubai. The studio delivers design
and build under one contract: interior design, renovation and fit-out, and landscaping.

- Location: Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Office 1603, Downtown Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971 50 399 9314 / +971 4 332 2002
- Email: info@hstarchitects.com
- Hours: Saturday to Thursday, 9am to 6pm (Gulf Standard Time)
- Areas served: Dubai, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, Emirates Hills, Damac Hills, District One, Jumeirah, Al Barsha, Al Wasl, Deira, Abu Dhabi

## Services
- [Interior Design](https://hstarchitects.com/services/interior-design/): Concept, space planning and 3D visualisation for villas, offices and showrooms.
- [Renovation & Fit-Out](https://hstarchitects.com/services/renovation/): Interior fit-out and refurbishment, delivered by the team that drew it.
- [Landscaping](https://hstarchitects.com/services/landscaping/): Gardens, terraces and outdoor rooms designed and built for the Gulf climate.
